cohort: 322 parturients who presented with an indication for an emergency caesarean section at the Gynecology and Obstetrics service of the Provincial Hospital Hassan 2, Settat Morocco
finding: The average DDI was 68.95 minutes, and over 78% of parturients had a DDI of more than 30 minutes; unavailability of the emergency kit, anesthetist team, and patient hesitation were significantly associated with prolonged DDI.
